Freego Nova 5 Mini Ebike for Teens and Adults

The Freego Nova 5 Mini is a compact electric mini bike built around the current specification data in Shopify. Key details include 1500 W (Nominal), 2500 W (Peak); Mid-drive Brushless DC, 48V, 21Ah (1008Wh), and 37 MPH (3 speed levels: 1 – 10 MPH, 3 – 37 MPH).

Riding range: Eco Mode (10 mph): up to 35 miles; Sport Mode (30 mph): up to 20 miles. Tested with rider weight 165 lbs, no cargo, flat road, 77 °F, no wind

Why Riders Choose the Freego Nova 5 Mini

The Freego Nova 5 Mini is designed for riders who want clear power delivery, practical controls, and a chassis matched to off-road and adventure use. Its specification set lists High-strength Steel Pipe, Hydraulic Front & Rear Shock Absorbers, and Front 14” / Rear 12” spoke wheels with alloy rims, tubed pneumatic puncture-resistant tires.

Key Specifications

Motor Power 1500 W (Nominal), 2500 W (Peak)
Mid-drive Brushless DC

Battery 48V, 21Ah (1008Wh)

Riding Range Eco Mode (10 mph): up to 35 miles; Sport Mode (30 mph): up to 20 miles. Tested with rider weight 165 lbs, no cargo, flat road, 77 °F, no wind

Top Speed 37 MPH (3 speed levels: 1 – 10 MPH, 3 – 37 MPH)

Motor Activation Electric throttle only

Controller Brushless Motor Controller, 60 A nominal / 240 A peak

Throttle Type Full-twist Throttle

Frame High-strength Steel Pipe

Display LCD Display

Max Load 220 lb (100 kg)

Charging Time 4-6 H

Charger Specification 54.6V, 3A

Net Weight 99 lb (45 kg) including battery

Brake System Hydraulic Disc Brakes, 2-piston, 203 mm rotors, front & rear

Transmission Gears 1:9.6 reduction via 2-stage speed reduction (pulley 23:51, chain sprocket 13:56)

Wheel Size & Tires Front 14” / Rear 12” spoke wheels with alloy rims, tubed pneumatic puncture-resistant tires

Suspension Hydraulic Front & Rear Shock Absorbers

Tubes Inflatable thick inner tubes

Lighting LED headlight and rear brake light

Package Size 59” × 11.8” × 32.7” (150 × 30 × 83 cm)

Range Note

Riding range is based on the listed test conditions in the specification. Actual range can vary with rider weight, speed, terrain, temperature, wind, tire pressure, payload, and riding mode.

1500 W (Nominal), 2500 W (Peak); Mid-drive Brushless DC

37 MPH (3 speed levels: 1 – 10 MPH, 3 – 37 MPH)
